outcome: maternity-related cost of health care services
cohort: Women with a live inpatient birth in the calendar year 2013
finding: The occurrence of severe maternal morbidity (SMM) was associated with an increase in maternity-related costs of 37% in the Commercial and 47% in the Medicaid population.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was independently predictive of increased delivery costs in both Commercial and Medicaid populations.
